name: G-STAR
blurb: South Korea's largest video game exhibition at BEXCO in Busan, with PC, mobile, console and VR exhibitors from dozens of countries.

editions.evidence: Official English overview page (gstar.or.kr/eng/gstar/gstar_info.do): 'Nov.18(Wed) ~ Nov.22(Sun), 2026', venue '[Offline] Bexco, Busan, Korea'. Homepage countdown also matched (45 days from 2026-10-05 extraction = 2026-11-19, the public-day start within that run).

notes: B2B/trade exhibition, not a guest-program convention — no celebrity/panelist guest list exists on the site (nav is EXHIBITOR/VISITOR/CONFERENCE/PASS/NEWS, no guest page), so guests is 'none'. Homepage og:image (images/logo.png) 404s, so the cover uses the real site logo (logo:0, main_logo.png) instead; no wide key-art banner is published — the hero banners found are a notice popup and crowd/venue photos, which the picking rules say to avoid.
